latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 of marketing-plan-canvas skill

- Launches a meta-orchestrator to assemble a complete 9-square, 1-Page Marketing Plan canvas for small and medium businesses.
- Integrates outputs from 10 dedicated marketing skills, or gathers minimum inputs directly from the user.
- Guides users through the "before, during, after" framework based on Allan Dib's 1-Page Marketing Plan.
- Produces a single coherent document (`marketing-plan-canvas.md`) with emphasis on creating a minimum-viable, actionable plan.
- Suitable for creating a plan from scratch, integrating partial work, or auditing/repairing an existing marketing system.
